environment.label: Linux x86_64 laptop (8 threads), PostgreSQL 16 container, release build
environment.notes: One run per configuration. Other light jobs (documentation builds) shared the machine.

workload.shape: guild-like object: settings, 12 member objects, 8 role ids, nested xp and welcome blocks
workload.timeline: load all, flush (5 s interval), 80 s without traffic, read 2000 random keys back, rewrite 10%, restart, read back
workload.verification: every read compared to the generated document: 0 mismatches in every configuration, before and after restart
